content.text: I found a concrete auth bug affecting Settings: Twyne gives Convex a callback that always returns the original token, even when Convex requests a fresh one. That can prevent an already-connected account from loading its link after the token expires. I’m fixing refresh handling and making Settings wait for Convex to confirm authentication.

The shared relay and token-refresh regression tests pass. I’m now checking the production build and auth lifecycle changes: reusing the active Bluesky session, clearing it when the SDK reports invalidation, and keeping an expired Bluesky session from delaying Twyne sign-in.
